name: Behaviour cloning
description: Offline imitation: an MLP with a masked softmax head regresses the target weights logged from the training sessions only, by five built-in strategies (1/N rebalanced, momentum, minimum variance, inverse volatility, trend following) and a Dirichlet-noised copy of each, 4 episodes of 128 sessions each, rewards and fills from the benchmark engine. The checkpoint with the best validation net Sharpe is kept. trials = 5: the default configuration plus a declared grid of 4 (2/4/8 episodes per behaviour, 1000-4000 steps, hidden 64/128), compared by mean validation Sharpe over the three ranked tasks and 2 seeds.
